Where should you actually connect the electrodes so that they will control the hand?

Actually, there a lot of possible places!

Think about:

  • What limb difference does the person you are designing for have? If someone is missing just their hand you probably will make different decisions than if they are missing their entire arm, or have other injuries.
  • What will be comfortable and easy to learn and use for the person you are designing for?
  • What will work well? Maybe the EMG reader picks up some body parts better than others.
  • Are there other considerations that you think are important?
Choose two muscles or parts of your body that you might want to use as the connection points for your user. Make sure to explain your reasoning.

• Muscle or part of the body for the two red wires
  • Why is this a good location for the user you are designing for?
  • Where will you connect the ground wire?
